title: Assess Quando? for people who lose track of time and propose a focus mode
note: Focus mode waits until after 4 Dec. Open for Curió: phone test of Quick setups, accept 15 plan suggestions in three docs, yes/no on wake-up check default.
details: What helps, what gets in the way, the gaps, how other apps help people keep track of time, a focus mode proposal, which updates the business, marketing and market plans need, and how to reach this audience. All five decisions are approved: the focus block after release, free for everyone, a first-run choice, a voluntary tester question with five interviews in each person's preferred format, and plan updates as suggestions. Waiting on the freeze to end before any build.
